metaDescription: Order custom workwear with a lid for your team. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing on hats, caps, and helmets.
introHtml: Workwear with a lid includes hats, caps, and helmets that keep your team protected and branded on the job. Whether you need custom baseball caps for a construction crew or branded hard hats for a safety program, adding a lid to your uniform program gives employees a practical accessory that also boosts visibility. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a professional finish that lasts through daily wear.
